styles.note: Average cost of the shares you held just before the ex-date (average-cost method: sold shares leave at their average cost). Excludes charges.
Yield on cost: dividend per share ÷ your average buy price. What this dividend pays on your money.
Filled by ./psx update: PSX closing price on the last trading day before the ex-date.
Market dividend yield: dividend per share ÷ price before the ex-date. The yield quoted by brokers and news; useful for comparing stocks.
Time-weighted return including dividends. Fair comparison with KSE-100. Not the same as your broker app; see Return on Cost %.
Same calculation as your broker app: Portfolio Value ÷ Cost of Holdings − 1.
Money you put in (buys incl. charges) minus money you took out (sells after charges) that month.

values.formulaValue: =IFERROR(ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(MAP($B$8:$B,$C$8:$C,LAMBDA(ex,s,IF(OR(ex="",s=""),"",SUMIFS('Trade List'!D:D,'Trade List'!B:B,s,'Trade List'!A:A,"<"&ex,'Trade List'!C:C,"Buy")-SUMIFS('Trade List'!D:D,'Trade List'!B:B,s,'Trade List'!A:A,"<"&ex,'Trade List'!C:C,"Sell")))),MAX(1,IFERROR(MAX(FILTER(ROW($C$8:$C),$C$8:$C<>"")),8)-7),1),"")

=MAP($S2:$S,LAMBDA(d,IF(d="","",SUMIFS('Trade List'!$D$2:$D,'Trade List'!$A$2:$A,d,'Trade List'!$B$2:$B,IF(Dashboard!$B$1="All Stocks","*",Dashboard!$B$1),'Trade List'!$C$2:$C,"Buy")-SUMIFS('Trade List'!$D$2:$D,'Trade List'!$A$2:$A,d,'Trade List'!$B$2:$B,IF(Dashboard!$B$1="All Stocks","*",Dashboard!$B$1),'Trade List'!$C$2:$C,"Sell"))))

=MAP($S2:$S,LAMBDA(d,IF(d="","",SUMIFS('Trade List'!$D$2:$D,'Trade List'!$A$2:$A,"<="&d,'Trade List'!$B$2:$B,IF(Dashboard!$B$1="All Stocks","*",Dashboard!$B$1),'Trade List'!$C$2:$C,"Buy")-SUMIFS('Trade List'!$D$2:$D,'Trade List'!$A$2:$A,"<="&d,'Trade List'!$B$2:$B,IF(Dashboard!$B$1="All Stocks","*",Dashboard!$B$1),'Trade List'!$C$2:$C,"Sell"))))
